facts.statement: measurement = Wilson-lower-bound over repeated runs, never a single run
looping/counting/splitting/scoring/recording live in tools/test-harness scripts; consume only exit codes and JSON, never prose stdout
single-query manual debugging via evaluator.py run
built-in-registered skill has no filesystem location; cannot be tested — surface and stop
source root = directory containing the skills/ dir; for <root>/.opencode/skills/<name> it is <root>/.opencode; not under skills/ → stop
harness is user-specified; ask when missing; never auto-detect installed harnesses
defaults: reps 3, timeout 30s, max-iterations 3 (hard cap 3, clamp and tell), train-frac 0.6
default queries path <source-root>/skills-workspace/<skill>/trigger-tests/queries.json
model/variant are optional, passed to eval executions only; campaign-driving model is the session's current model
persistent campaign dir via campaign-init, campaign-YYYY-MM-DD suffixed -2/-3 on same-day reruns; never removed
missing queries file → offer to generate per conventions; user approves before saving
workspace init → sync → status; status must pass before any eval
record the split seed from <campaign>/split.json
planned max spend = train×reps×max-iterations + validate×reps + reps sanity; user confirms before first eval
sealed pool: 3 fresh should-trigger queries per campaign, never shown to loop, never trained on, never reused
pass testing skill's own agents/ via --agents-dir; suite exit 1 → abort, no retries; never run reps as default agent
save each iteration's evaluated description as iter-<i>-description.md in the campaign dir
all-void suite → abort as broken conditions; zero-failure train round → early exit
winner = highest train score across iterations; ties go to the earlier iteration
validate skipped when ≤10 queries; below-train validate → informational overfit warning only; validate runs once, at end, against winner
sanity pass = triggered ≥60% of non-void runs; all-void = inconclusive; failure → stop, no write-back offer, never restart
write-back replaces only the description field; other fields and body preserved byte-for-byte
record only after passed sanity + resolved write-back; score = validate (else winner's train); never record declined/failed/inconclusive
cleanup workspace on completion (pass or fail); on abort keep workspace and print paths; campaign dir never removed
python3 (else python) on PATH, must be >= 3.10, used for every script invocation; evaluator.py check --harness verifies the harness binary
vary should-trigger queries across phrasing formality, explicitness, detail level, complexity
substantive enough that the skill would genuinely help; realistic concrete details
negatives = near-misses sharing the skill's vocabulary but asking something else; reject zero-overlap weak negatives
self-contained by construction; no references to files/context absent in a bare workspace
categorize only from cited phrases in failed-run reasoning; never from query text or outcome patterns
check timeouts counts first; a cluster → infrastructure (slow provider, step cap), not the description
mapping: didn't fire → too narrow → broaden; false-trigger → too broad → add specificity; repeated → local minimum → reframe skeleton
eval agents see frontmatter-only stubs; a body/label conflict cannot explain failures
should-not false-trigger across structurally different framings → suspect setup; surface to user, stop iterating
fails under every candidate in every iteration → suspect query; flag in report with timeouts count; never rewrite query or fabricate files
guardrails: fix category not query; no keyword pasting; imperative; err pushy; 1024-char cap; never first person; skeleton not adjectives
mid-loop revisions rewrite the whole workspace stub (same name + pre-existing fields, no body); source file edited only on confirmed write-back
opencode agent-fallback warning → HarnessExecutionError, suite aborts, no JSON; treat as campaign abort (contamination)
check / agent-install / split / query-file validation failure → stop before any spend, surface the exact message
keep queries verbatim across the whole campaign; mid-campaign edits invalidate comparisons
manifest written only by evaluator.py record; one per skill at skills-workspace/<skill>/manifest.json; overwrites only own track's key
trigger-track checksum hashes frontmatter only (--scope frontmatter); body-only edits never invalidate a recorded score

excluded.reason: skill-name resolution via session registry metadata is driving-session mechanics, not observable in a bare eval agent's answer
report template is followed in-context during the report step; standalone elicitation needs a full synthetic campaign dataset
manifest line states are template mechanics followed in-context; same dataset problem as F-report-01
winner-equals-source → no write-back offer is baseline no-diff reasoning; a competent agent answers correctly without the doc
